title: Xiaomi unveils its MiMo V2 AI models, including the 1T-parameter MiMo V2 Pro, codenamed Hunter Alpha, which Xiaomi says benchmarks close to GPT-5.2 and Opus 4.6 (Carl Franzen/VentureBeat)
summary: Carl Franzen / VentureBeat: Xiaomi unveils its MiMo V2 AI models, including the 1T-parameter MiMo V2 Pro, codenamed Hunter Alpha, which Xiaomi says benchmarks close to GPT-5.2 and Opus 4.6 — Led by Fuli Luo, a veteran of the disruptive DeepSeek R1 project, the release represents what Luo characterizes as a “quiet ambush” on the global frontier.
